description.narrative:
Project Outcome: The Project aims to deepen Perus sustainable building finance market by expanding access to climate finance for sustainable mortgages, leveraging IFCs previous engagements with local financial institutions.
Market Outcome: The Project is expected to contribute to the sustainable growth of Perus green buildings finance market by increasing financing volumes and promoting wider adoption of the EDGE certification.

The proposed investment consists of an up to US$200 million Basel II-compliant Tier 2 subordinated financing package to Banco BBVA Peru (BBVA Peru or the Bank), the second-largest bank in Peru and long-term strategic partner of IFC. The financing aims to strengthen the Banks green mortgage portfolio and strengthen the Banks regulatory capital base to support its growth (the Project).
